name: Freestyle

modes.label: On-demand (allocated, per second)
modes.note: Same rates on Free/Hobby/Pro. Per-VM max depends on plan (Free 4/8, Hobby 8/16, Pro 32/64). Monthly allowances (200 vCPU-h, 400 GiB-h RAM, 60,000 GiB-h storage) are applied first on every plan. Paused VMs bill storage only. No idle timeout by default. Resize is up-only. Basis verified 2026-09-28: "vCPU, memory and storage are all billed on the amount allocated to the VM for the time it is allocated — a reserved core is yours whether or not the guest is busy." ; "A paused VM holds no compute reservation, so it bills only for storage while it sleeps." (https://www.freestyle.sh/docs/vms/pricing-and-limits).

modes.label: Enterprise active-CPU pricing
modes.commit_note: Enterprise contract only; rates unpublished. RAM basis under this option is not stated (assumed allocated).
modes.note: Docs: 'bill on measured CPU time rather than allocated vCPU'. Not priceable until sales quote. Basis verified 2026-09-28: "Active CPU pricing — bill on measured CPU time rather than allocated vCPU, so you only pay for compute you actually use." (same URL). RAM basis and floor unpublished.

modes.label: Enterprise node-based (dedicated capacity, flat rate)
modes.commit_note: Enterprise: 'reserve dedicated capacity at a flat rate instead of per-resource usage billing'; separate 'commitment discounts' for usage/spend commitments. All rates unpublished.
modes.note: Not priceable; placeholder so the regime is visible.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Allowances are HARD STOPS (VMs paused when exhausted; no overage). 10 saved VMs, 10 snapshots, account totals 40 vCPU/80 GiB/320 GB, 32 GB disk/VM, 50 GB transfer (not 500). No custom sizing. Pricing page says no persistent VMs/snapshots; docs say persistent VMs are allowed.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.note: $50 minimum spend, fully usable as usage (applied after the free allowances). 200 saved VMs, 1,000 snapshots, 64 GB disk/VM, account 800 vCPU/1.56 TiB/3,125 GB (disk budget caps you at 97 default VMs saved).

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $500 minimum spend, fully usable as usage. 4,000 saved VMs, 12,000 snapshots, 256 GB disk/VM, account 16,000 vCPU/31.25 TiB/62,500 GB.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom limits (e.g. ubuntu-3xl 64 vCPU/128 GiB), active-CPU / node-based / commitment pricing, SAML SSO & SCIM, audit logs, 99.99% SLA. Pricing by quote.

perf_source: cpu_runs_s 9.64: hpc-sandbox-benchmarks (branch provider/ascii-box, docs/results/2026-08-24-cpu), measured 2026-08-24 on the platform default VM (4 vCPU / 8 GiB). burst 1,088.1 ms: ComputeSDK (github.com/computesdk/benchmarks results/) burst TTI 2026-09-25 (activated 2026-08-31). No cold-start or DAX result.

knobs.label: Share of session running (pause when idle)
knobs.why: Freestyle VMs bill allocated vCPU/RAM per second while running and have NO idle timeout by default; paused VMs bill storage only. Setting idleTimeoutSeconds (network-inactivity based) or calling vm.pause() between steps bills only the running share; 1 (default) = never paused.

caveats: free.monthly_credit 18.38 = dollar value of per-resource allowances (200 vCPU-h $8.06 + 400 GiB-h RAM $5.16 + 60,000 GiB-h storage $5.16). The allowances are NOT fungible: each only offsets its own resource. They apply on every plan before the fee credit, and on Free they are hard caps.
egress_free_gib 500 applies to Hobby/Pro; Free includes 50 GB and stops there. Transfer counts bytes in BOTH directions (ingress too). VPC-internal traffic is free.

disk_gib_month = $0.000086/GiB-h x 730. Disk is billed on allocated size (default 32 GB) while running, paused or stopped. Ephemeral VMs (autoDeleteSeconds 0) stop billing disk when deleted. There is no per-sandbox free disk, but the 60,000 GiB-h monthly allowance covers ~82 GiB kept all month.

Retained state priced at the storage rate ($0.000086/GiB-h = $0.06278/GiB-month): docs say "A paused VM holds no compute reservation, so it bills only for storage while it sleeps." Named-snapshot storage has no separate published price (only count limits 10/1,000/12,000); treated as the same storage rate (unverified). Whether a paused VM's saved RAM image counts as storage is undocumented.
No default idle timeout: VMs bill until paused/stopped/deleted. idleTimeoutSeconds is network-activity based, so CPU-only jobs can be paused. Marketing's ~30 s auto-suspend is not in the docs.
Enterprise active-CPU, node-based and commitment-discount rates are unpublished (modes left null).
Allowances were DAILY on an older pricing page (20 vCPU-h/40 GiB-h/16,800 GiB-h storage per day); they are now monthly (200/400/60,000). The change date is unknown.
No dedicated IPv4: every VM gets a public IPv6, and all VMs in an account share one outbound IPv4.
Regions not documented; 'us' inferred from the Latitude.sh San Jose peering note.
cold_start_ms: no computesdk cold-start run for freestyle (vendor claims ~65 ms); dax never succeeded in benchmarks.

free.monthly_credit ($18.38) values separate monthly resource allowances (200 CPU-h, 400 GiB-h RAM, 60,000 GiB-h disk per the 2026-09-24 capture); it is not a pooled spendable credit, so unused disk allowance cannot offset CPU in reality. A 2026-07-08 capture advertised per-day allowances (20 CPU-h / 40 GiB-h / 16,800 GiB-h disk); do not reuse current allowances for historical estimates. https://web.archive.org/web/20260708095940/https://www.freestyle.sh/pricing , https://web.archive.org/web/20260924112048/https://www.freestyle.sh/pricing

fleet.verification: No card to start. Adding a card causes a $1 verification charge automatically refunded; paid upgrades fund monthly usage minimums.
fleet.tiers: Free 10 concurrent/10 saved; Hobby 40 concurrent/200 saved; Pro 400 concurrent/4,000 saved; Enterprise custom. Active CPU/RAM pools: Free 40 vCPU/80 GiB; Hobby 800 vCPU/1.56 TiB; Pro 16,000 vCPU/31.25 TiB. Disk budget counts all saved VMs.
fleet.notes: 10 fits Free if resources and usage suffice; 50/300 require Pro, 1,000 Enterprise. Separate aggregate resource and saved-VM/snapshot quotas apply; paused VMs free concurrent slots but remain saved.
